explanation: Pointing directly at someone with a single index finger is widely described as impolite across Arab countries, including Egypt, since it can come across as accusatory. The more common and accepted alternative is to gesture with the whole open hand toward the person or direction.
local_tip: Indicate a person or direction with your whole hand rather than a single pointed finger.

also_check.note: Pointing with a single finger is considered impolite; gesturing with the whole hand is preferred.
Pointing with the index finger is common and generally unremarkable in casual settings.
Index-finger pointing is considered offensive; many instead point with the thumb.

sources.title: Common Gestures People Use in Arab Countries
